faults.title: Crankshaft bearing fault (2014-15 Cooper S)
faults.description: Autocar warns that 2014-2015 Cooper S models were recalled for a defective crankshaft bearing, with engines rebuilt or replaced. Check the full engine was replaced, since other parts may have been damaged.

faults.title: High oil use on hotter models
faults.description: Autocar says high oil consumption is common on the hotter versions of the 2014-2024 hatch, so check the oil level and look for yearly servicing.

faults.title: Knocking front suspension bushes
faults.description: Worn front control arm bushes cause a knocking noise from the front suspension. Autocar puts a new bush at around £30.

faults.title: Paint rubbed by door seals and cloudy mirrors
faults.description: The door seal rubber can wear through the paint on the door shuts. Autocar also flags clouding wing mirror glass, which it says costs about £20 to replace.

faults.title: Heated seat faults
faults.description: Check the heated seats work and the dashboard light stays on when switched on. Autocar says a fault is down to either the heating element or the control module.
